scope: Observed reviewed source behavior; not a hosted runbook or authorization to pause/resume

states.paused: Refuse new producer operations, uploads and summary claims; create no partial operation or reservation
Permit only exact already-admitted work under current source/access and completion guards; keep obligations until proven completion
Keep queued and counted; do not attach a new operation, dispatch providers, cancel, expire or release it
Permit exact domain completion and one receipt finish; uncertainty stays counted, without automatic repeat or reattachment
Keep counted and block resume until reviewed resolution; private DB-only Apply no-save path is separately bounded
Explicit current-revision resume may reopen admission once active/unreconciled leases are clear; queued obligations remain counted and must pass fresh source/access checks before claim
Cannot claim queued work until explicit resume or reattach already-claimed work after a lost reply; reconnecting is not cancellation or completion evidence

drain_semantics.tracked_operations_clear: Only active and unresolved held leases, excluding the reviewed immutable Apply no-save credit
drain_semantics.required_followup: Expose/review retained queued and promised obligations separately from active leases before final drain acceptance
